dishes.name: Margherita pizza
dishes.recipe: Top a gluten-free base with tomato sauce, mozzarella and basil. Bake at 250 C until the crust is crisp and the cheese is bubbling.

dishes.name: Mushroom pizza
dishes.recipe: Spread tomato sauce over a gluten-free base, add sliced mushrooms and mozzarella, then bake until golden. Finish with parsley.

lapland-kitchen.name: Example: Lapland special: salmon soup and blueberry pie

dishes.name: Salmon soup
dishes.recipe: Simmer potatoes, carrots and leek in fish stock until tender. Add salmon and cream, cook gently until just done, and finish with dill.

dishes.name: Blueberry pie
dishes.recipe: Fill a shortcrust pastry with blueberries tossed with sugar and potato starch. Bake until the berries bubble, then cool before slicing.
